datasets.name: MSMARCO Trimmed
datasets.description: Large-scale real-world web search queries paired with relevant passages for open-domain QA and passage ranking.

details.purpose: Evaluate large-scale passage retrieval and open-domain question answering
details.format: Natural language queries with one or more relevant passages and sparse relevance labels
details.challenges: Noisy user queries, lexical mismatch, sparse supervision

datasets.name: NFCorpus Trimmed
datasets.description: Consumer health question answering and retrieval over curated medical information documents.

details.purpose: Assess retrieval for layperson medical and health information needs
details.format: Health-related questions with graded relevance judgments over medical articles

datasets.name: SciDocs Trimmed
datasets.description: Scientific document retrieval and citation-oriented recommendation over scholarly publications.

details.purpose: Evaluate retrieval on scientific literature with citation/context signals
details.format: Queries formed from paper titles/abstracts with relevance derived from citation and usage graphs
details.challenges: Domain jargon, multi-task signals, long document abstracts

datasets.name: ArXivQA
datasets.description: Scientific question answering over ArXiv papers combining textual and visual (figure) content.

details.purpose: Evaluate multi-modal scientific document comprehension and question answering
details.format: Questions paired with paper passages, figures and captions
details.challenges: Complex notation, figure interpretation, multi-modal reasoning

datasets.name: DocVQA
datasets.description: Visual document question answering over scanned and photographed documents.

details.purpose: Evaluate visual document understanding and question answering
details.format: Questions paired with real-world document images
details.challenges: OCR noise, layout structure, visual-text alignment

datasets.name: InfoVQA
datasets.description: Question answering over infographics and charts requiring visual data interpretation.

details.purpose: Evaluate understanding of infographics, charts and visually encoded data
details.format: Questions about infographic and chart visuals
details.challenges: Visual reasoning, data extraction, multi-modal synthesis

datasets.name: TabFQuAD
datasets.description: Table-focused QA over financial and structured tabular data.

details.purpose: Evaluate table understanding and financial QA
details.format: Questions about structured tables and associated figures
details.challenges: Table structure parsing, numerical reasoning, financial context

datasets.name: ESG Reports

datasets.name: Biomedical Lectures

details.size: 1020 corpuses (from 27 unique documents), 640 queries, 2060 QA pairs

Light version: 1010 corpuses (from 264 unique documents), 300 queries, 1200 QA pairs

metrics.name: NDCG
metrics.description: Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain measures the quality of ranking by considering both relevance and position.

details.formulaPlain: NDCG at k equals DCG at k divided by IDCG at k.
details.advantages: Considers graded relevance and position bias
details.use_case: Best for evaluating ranking quality when multiple relevance levels exist

metrics.name: Recall
metrics.description: Measures the proportion of relevant documents that are retrieved in the top-K results.

details.formulaPlain: Recall at k equals the number of relevant documents retrieved in the top k divided by the total number of relevant documents.
details.interpretation: 1.0 = all relevant documents retrieved, 0.0 = no relevant documents retrieved
details.use_case: Important when you need to find as many relevant documents as possible

metrics.name: Precision
metrics.description: Measures the proportion of retrieved documents that are relevant in the top-K results.

details.formulaPlain: Precision at k equals the number of relevant documents in the top k results divided by k.
details.interpretation: 1.0 = all retrieved documents are relevant, 0.0 = no retrieved documents are relevant
details.use_case: Important when false positives are costly

metrics.name: MAP
metrics.description: Mean Average Precision calculates the average precision across all queries at different recall levels.

details.formulaPlain: MAP at k equals the mean of Average Precision at k over all queries.
details.interpretation: Summarizes precision-recall curve in a single number
details.use_case: Good overall metric for comparing retrieval systems

metrics.name: MRR
metrics.description: Mean Reciprocal Rank measures how quickly the first relevant document is found.

details.formulaPlain: MRR at k equals the mean over queries of the reciprocal rank of the first relevant document (capped at k).
details.interpretation: 1.0 = first result always relevant, lower values = relevant results appear later
details.advantages: Focuses on finding at least one relevant document quickly
details.use_case: Important when users typically only look at the first few results
